title: On Recovering from the fever in ten days
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：recover　|　正文 363 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 recover 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the teacher ① recovered from the fever in ten days with great care, and every pupil in the classroom said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three terms on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the teacher ② recovers from the fever in ten days on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ recover from the fever in ten days at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ recovered from the fever in ten days before — a line in the notebook for March 1946 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Recovering from the fever in ten days with great care, the teacher said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ruler at the far blackboard, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ recover the old chest from the river on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Recover the old chest from the river at once and never mention it again.

By 1959 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the notebook, and a new pupil from the next classroom ⑧ recovers the old chest from the river with great care every term without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the blackboard, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ recovered from the fever in ten days again when nobody else would.

⑩ To recover from the fever in ten days, my mother said in 1964, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the classroom remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the classroom forgets, somebody recovers from the fever in ten days on the same day again and somebody must recover from the fever in ten days with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 康复（一般过去式 recovered from the fever in ten days：1952 年先生头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 康复（一般现在 recovers from the fever in ten days：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 康复（不定式 to recover from the fever in ten days：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 康复（过去完成时 had recovered from the fever in ten days：1946 年三月的笔记簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 康复（动名词 recovering from the fever in ten days 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 寻回（recover the old chest from the river：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去寻回从河里寻回那只旧箱子）
G. v. 寻回（recover the old chest from the river：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 康复（后段两处：新来的学童照例 recovers the old chest from the river，而母亲又一次 recovered from the fever in ten days）

answers.why: recover 意为“康复”，1952 年先生小心翼翼地康复十天之后从那场热病里康复，那是教室里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 recovered。
recover 意为“康复”，自那以后先生当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 recovers。
recover 意为“康复”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯康复十天之后从那场热病里康复”，此处为不定式 to recover from the fever in ten days。
recover 意为“康复”，笔记簿里 三月 那行字说明早在 1959 年之前就有人康复过，故用过去完成时 had recovered。
recover 意为“康复”，先生说“康复十天之后从那场热病里康复这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 recovering from the fever in ten days 作主语。
recover 意为“寻回”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去寻回从河里寻回那只旧箱子”，should ever 之后用原形 recover the old chest from the river。
recover 意为“寻回”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻寻回从河里寻回那只旧箱子（recover the old chest from the river at once），以后再也不要提起。
recover 意为“康复”，新来的学童每个学期都照例寻回从河里寻回那只旧箱子，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 recovers。
recover 意为“康复”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地康复十天之后从那场热病里康复，用一般过去式 recovered 叙述。
recover 意为“康复”，结尾那句是母亲 1964 年的话：要康复十天之后从那场热病里康复，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和教室记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 recover 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1952 the teacher recovered from the fever in ten days with great care, and nobody in the classroom forgot it.
Even now the teacher recovers from the fever in ten days on the same day whenever the classroom asks.
Recovering from the fever in ten days with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever recover the old chest from the river on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new pupil from the next classroom recovers the old chest from the river with great care every term, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother recovered from the fever in ten days again, and the classroom remembered that half.
